headline: Failed House rule would have set debate terms for a bill on state vehicle emission waivers and the 2024 defense spending bill.
what_it_does: This was a procedural resolution, called a "rule," that would have set the terms for House debate on two bills. One was H.R. 1435, which would change how the Clean Air Act lets states set their own emission standards for new cars and engines, including efforts to end sales of gas-powered vehicles. The other was H.R. 4365, the bill funding the Department of Defense for fiscal year 2024. The rule itself would not have changed any law; it would only have allowed the House to take up those bills.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: It would have set the rules for how and when they could debate, amend, and vote on the two bills.
